evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'You have about five or ten minutes to go over those details' — no time-boxed framing with the dependable-quote promise, and no wait for customer agreement before continuing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep skipped the 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns' question entirely. Jumped straight to address confirmation after customer said 'I don't think so' in response to a generic 'any questions or concerns.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised several concerns (nice furniture needing wrapping, adjusters on legs, tempered glass bed, heavy items). Rep acknowledged with 'Okay' / 'Not a problem' but never dug deeper — no 'tell me more about that' follow-up on any of them.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection given. Customer's concerns about furniture protection, leg adjusters, and heavy items were acknowledged individually but never reflected back as a full summary.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered property type (apartment/duplex), floor/stories (1st floor origin, 2 stories destination), rooms (1 bed/2 bed), walking distance (50 ft), special considerations (couch, furniture, bed, entertainment center, dresser, standing desk, TVs, kitchen items). All major logistics items present.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' — only discussed TV bags and padding/wrapping existing items.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asked 'A typical move a box out for a move the size about 1525 boxes. Do you think you fall within that range?' — box count anchor was asked.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gave hourly rate ($208/hr) and trip fee ($150) but never anchored to a typical range for this home size (812 sq ft, 1-bedroom move). Quote was already presented to customer before call started; no new anchor or personalization to this customer's situation on the call itself.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep mentioned trip fee ($150) and hourly rate ($208) upfront, but never delivered the 'not a guess' / 2.5-hour minimum / 15-minute increments commitment framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' — jumped straight from pricing recap to 'Do you have any other questions for me while I'm on the line?'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Not mentioned at all on the call.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Not mentioned at all on the call.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No 'Two Promises' section delivered, so no closing statement like 'Does that put those to rest?'
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asked 'Do you have any other questions for me while I'm on the line?' — this is the throwaway 'any questions?' variant, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' frame.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' — booking was already in the system (customer said 'it looks like we are moving') and rep moved directly to confirmation logistics and sign-off without an explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partially confirmed. Rep confirmed: arrival window (12:45–2:45 PM), addresses (origin and destination with unit numbers), and noted crew details would be sent via email. Missing: date explicitly re-confirmed in conversation (Sept 29 was mentioned at top but not re-confirmed), phone number re-confirmed, crew size discussed, and notes about customer's concerns (furniture wrapping, leg adjusters, furniture protection) were never captured for the crew.

top_strength: Brianne gathered comprehensive logistics details across both properties (room count, floor levels, walking distance, special items, TV sizes, kitchen furniture) and correctly discussed TV padding/bag options, demonstrating strong product knowledge.
coaching_note: The call skipped the entire discovery conversation structure: no quid-pro-quo framing, no 'what else are you concerned about' probe, no Two Promises, and no explicit closing ask — this felt like a confirmation call for an already-booked move rather than a sales call, which left critical trust-building moments (damage coverage, on-time guarantee) and concern-capture entirely off the table.
